title: Root SMP Modpack
description: This modpack is a collection of a few content mods which is made for the Root SMP. It is a vanilla++ survival server.
body:
The Root SMP Modpack is primarily made for the Root SMP (discord link is given). It is based on Fabric 1.21.10 and will be updated to the latest version as soon as all the major mods update. We have tried to keep the number of mods as less as possible and configured it to be vanilla-friendly.

Mod List -
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Entity Model and Texture Features - Allows usage of resource packs
- Enderscape - Complete rehaul of End Dimension (basically 1.16-like update, but for Nether)
- Traveller's Backpack - Backpacks :slight_smile:
- Nature's Compass - Allows you to find any biome using a compass
- Farmer's Delight - For all the chefs and farmers out there
- Waystones - Allows you to teleport to other waystones. We don't have jetpacks, and Elytra is end game item. It requires scrolls to use, so it's not like permanent teleportation
- Universal Shops - Allows you to make player shops where you can sell/buy items
- Universal Graves - So items won't despawn
- Quality of Life Mods - Jade, Right Click Harvest, Durability Tooltip, Better Advancements and F3, Dynamic Lights
- Extended Item Viewer - Use this until Just Enough Items (JEI) is released for 1.21.10
- Building Mods - Macaw's Bridges and Mr Crayfish Furniture for all the builders
- Friends and Foes - Adds all the mobs that lost the mob vote (Mojang suggested them, so it's vanilla)
- Veinmine Enchantment
- Iris - Allows usage of shaders
- Xaero's World and Minimap - Cave Mode will be disabled to preserve secret bases
- Sodium and other optimization mods
- LootR - New players can also get loot

</details>



This modpack uses configs of [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop). Thanks to their amazing work!
